mapper.select: SELECT dc.id, dc.document_id, dc.user_id, dc.content, dc.parent_id, dc.comment_time, dc.is_deleted, u.username, u.real_name, u.avatar FROM document_comment dc LEFT JOIN user u ON dc.user_id = u.id WHERE dc.id = #{id} AND dc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT dc.id, dc.document_id, dc.user_id, dc.content, dc.parent_id, dc.comment_time, dc.is_deleted, u.username, u.real_name, u.avatar FROM document_comment dc LEFT JOIN user u ON dc.user_id = u.id WHERE dc.document_id = #{documentId} AND dc.is_deleted = 0 AND dc.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY dc.comment_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_comment WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND parent_id IS NULL

SELECT dc.id, dc.document_id, dc.user_id, dc.content, dc.parent_id, dc.comment_time, dc.is_deleted, u.username, u.real_name, u.avatar FROM document_comment dc LEFT JOIN user u ON dc.user_id = u.id WHERE dc.parent_id = #{parentId} AND dc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY dc.comment_time ASC
